editorial:
Imagine coming home to find out your parents are ghosts, but instead of being scary, they just want to make sure you are doing your homework and eating your vegetables. You get a wild ride with this one, where a dead couple comes back to life to protect their two kids. They have to deal with new step-parents who are not exactly nice and a greedy person trying to steal their home. The vibe is a strange mix of a family drama and a ghost story, making you feel for the kids while waiting for something creepy to happen around every corner.

You will notice that the acting is a bit over the top, which actually makes it more fun to watch. The pacing is a bit slow in the middle, but the revenge parts make up for it. If you love old-school horror that does not take itself too seriously, you should definitely give this a shot. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend.
endingExplained: In the end, the ghost parents finally get their revenge on the person who killed them. They use their powers to scare the villains away and make sure the evil step-parents are gone for good. Once the house is safe and the kids are protected, the parents realize they cannot stay in the living world forever. They say a sad but sweet goodbye to their children and finally cross over to the other side in peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s horror and ghost stories with a lot of heart.
